review_notes: I read the whole file and the `blockSubst` definition and lemmas in BlockSubstitution.lean. `iteratedBlockSubst` is a recursive construction. Each step is `rename (Fin.consEquiv _)` applied to `blockSubst p q`, where `blockSubst p q := bind₁ (fun i => rename (Prod.mk i) q) p`. It reuses Mathlib's `rename`, `Fin.consEquiv`, `eval` and `IsHomogeneous`, and I found no parallel notion of any of these. I did not search Mathlib for an existing iterated-substitution or plethysm-style definition. The file defines no new structure or class that competes with Mathlib. The only possible overlap is `blockSubst` as a named specialisation of `bind₁` and `rename`, which the rubric says is not a defect. A confident duplicate would need an independent Mathlib declaration for the same concept, and I found none. Remaining uncertainty: that missing Mathlib search.
